title: Market scan from seeded landscape facts
objective: Measure whether the market-scan craftbook scopes a boundary and writes a sourced landscape report across size, segments, players, trends, risks, and takeaway.
prompt: In the `Market Scan Eval` project, read `source/market-sources.md` and write `scan.md` about the US design-studio operations software market in 2026. State the market boundary and exclusions, cover size/growth, segments, players, drivers, trends, risks, and a so-what takeaway. Cite every sized figure with source id and year.

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for market-scan. The landscape facts are seeded in workspace/source/market-sources.md.
setup.missionObjectives: Write a boundary-scoped, source-cited market scan from seeded facts without live web access.

files.content:
# Seeded market sources

[1] Studio Ops Survey 2026: US independent design studios spent an estimated $420M on operations software in 2025, growing 12% year over year.
[2] Buyer interviews 2026: key segments are solo studios, 2-20 person boutique firms, and multi-location design-build groups.
[3] Vendor notes 2026: notable players include StudioBinder Ops, Ivy Workspace, DesignFiles, HoneyBook, and Boreal Desk; Boreal Desk is strongest in returns workflows.
[4] Trend memo 2026: three trends are AI-assisted admin, client portal consolidation, and returns/refunds workflow automation.
[5] Risk memo 2026: risks include low willingness to switch CRMs, privacy expectations, and fragmented warehouse integrations.
[6] Boundary note 2026: market boundary is US independent design studios with 1-100 employees. Exclude general construction ERP and consumer furniture marketplaces.

success.summary: workspace/scan.md scopes the market boundary, cites seeded figures, maps segments/players/trends/risks, and closes with a decision-ready takeaway.

checks.pattern: boundary|exclude|US independent design studios|construction ERP|furniture marketplaces

checks.label: do not invent citation ids beyond the seeded [1]-[6] sources

checks.pattern: projected|projection(?:s)?|expected to grow|forecast|CAGR|TAM|SAM|SOM|global|worldwide|robust|significant growth trajectory|mature enough|maturing past|core growth segment|large design-build|specialized tools|specialized solutions|seamless|best positioned|future market success|high-level operational efficiency|vendor lock-in|regulatory scrutiny|powerful drivers
checks.label: remove unsupported market-sizing, forecast, and maturity claims

patterns.label: stay inside the US market boundary
